sections.heading: Film recipes
items: File → Export Recipe writes the per-shot prompts your film was built from
File → Import Recipe rebuilds a film from one, so a film moves between this app, the web editor, and a teammate
Rebuilding always uses our own engine — someone else's recipe cannot spend your credits at flagship rates

sections.heading: Known limits
items: This build is not signed or notarised by Apple: the first launch needs Privacy & Security → Open Anyway
Generation covers video only — image, audio, and upscale models are not offered yet
Reference images and reference video are not accepted, which keeps your footage on your machine
There is no in-app updater yet: Check for Updates opens the download page
The speech panel's silence controls are English-only for now
Exported recipes carry the visuals, not the narration text; comparing takes side by side is still web-only

sections.heading: Re-shoot one shot from the timeline
items: Right-click a generated clip: Re-shoot This Shot, Another Composition, or Three More Takes
The shot you already have is never overwritten — a re-shoot adds a take, and the swap is a single undo away
Free on your subscription, and only offered on shots made with our own engine

sections.heading: Generation feels faster
items: Shots now land on the timeline as each one finishes, instead of all at once at the end
Measured: on an 8-shot film the first shot is ready in about 40 seconds while the whole film takes five minutes — you can start cutting while the rest renders

sections.heading: Fixes carried over from upstream
items: Saving a project no longer races the snapshot it is writing — a save issued mid-edit could previously block or drop the newest change
The open and save panels are pre-warmed at launch, so the first Open no longer stalls for a second
Scrubbing no longer fills the audio cache automatically, which kept the timeline responsive on long projects

sections.heading: New
items: Remove Dead Air is now configurable: set the minimum pause it should cut and how much speech padding to keep
Word-level removal is available to the agent panel as a tool, so you can ask for a phrase to be cut by name

sections.heading: First public release
items: Multi-track editing, colour, effects, captions, and export all run on your Mac
AI shot generation goes through the METAG gateway: sign in once, pay per shot, failed jobs are refunded
On-device transcription and captions via Apple SpeechAnalyzer — audio never leaves your Mac, and it is free
Agent panel drives the timeline with your own Anthropic key; the same tools are exposed over local MCP
Interface available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish
